structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "TikTokus" (TIKTOK) on a PumpSwap pair, 31 minutes old, reached about $1.04M market cap with $349K liquidity and $3.15M of volume in its first hour. Its description claims to be the "TikTok Official Token", created on x.com/tiktok_us. It was not launched on pump.fun (the address has no pump suffix and the launchpad is null). The packet lists at least 7 other tokens with the identical name "TikTokus" or "TikTokUS" and the same TIKTOK ticker, all launched in the past days or hours. Every one of them now has $0.01–$0.04 of liquidity and zero volume, which means they were drained. This one fits that series exactly. Top-10 holders own 98.2% of supply, the creator wallet still holds a very large balance, one of the top markets has 0% of its LP locked, and only 104 unique sellers traded against 3,766 unique buyers. That seller-to-buyer imbalance is a common sign of a honeypot, sell restrictions, or a coordinated setup where only insiders can exit.

narrative.description: This is an impersonation of an official TikTok / TikTok US token, likely riding news about TikTok US ownership or restructuring. The story is borrowed and not credible: there is no website, no DexScreener profile, and the only link is a claimed X handle, which is a standard fake-official scheme.
narrative.why_spreading: The spread comes from buyers who believe the 'official TikTok token' claim, plus bot and sniper activity. There is also another TIKTOK token ('Tiktok Coin', 8H2n...) doing $7.3M volume in the past hour, which suggests a real attention spike around a TikTok event. Scammers are serially cloning into that spike rather than building a lasting narrative.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link to TikTok is the name and a claimed X handle. The same 'TikTokus' name and description are reused across many drained clones, so this token is one more instance in a series, not the canonical one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 8H2n523q... 'Tiktok Coin' ($4.4M mcap, $298K liquidity, $7.3M volume in 1h) is the attention leader. 9v7YPoMm...pump 'TikTok US' ($2.0M mcap). There are at least 7 same-name 'TikTokus/TikTokUS' clones (5xuM..., C2RF..., 2PsC..., 5PCx..., DjPx..., 7KDQ..., 4iuX..., AYB2...), all with near-zero liquidity after being drained.

authenticity.evidence: The same deployer template (name 'TikTokus', non-pump.fun mint, description claiming it is official) has appeared repeatedly, and each previous instance ended at $0.03–0.04 of liquidity. Top-10 holders own 98.2%, and the creator balance is large. There are 3,766 unique buyers but only 104 unique sellers, and after the first ~15 minutes new sellers almost stop appearing (101 at m15 rising only to 104 at h1). RugCheck flags unlocked LP and few LP providers. The deployer's wallet shows 0 other tokens, which is consistent with a fresh wallet used for each launch.
authenticity.uncertainty: I cannot confirm that sells are restricted or that this creator wallet is linked to the earlier clones. The top-10 figure may include the pool account. However, liquidity of $349K would not account for most of a 98% supply share.
